# v0.1.0

First release of the unofficial MENNEKES AMTRON integration for Home
Assistant: local Modbus RTU over RS-485, full sensor coverage, safe charging
control, diagnostics and repair issues.

Validated against an AMTRON 4You 310 11 C2 on Modbus register layout v01.03.

**Start in read-only mode.** A new config entry never writes and never sends
the heartbeat. Switch the control mode to *Modbus master* in the entry options
only after you have confirmed that no other Modbus master drives the same
RS-485 bus.

Read `docs/safety.md` before enabling control. The charging-current register
has three different meanings depending on the value written, and this
integration is the thing that keeps the dangerous two out of reach.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full list.
